derivation: amendment A2: one finding per offending annotation. Two independent pairs (en twice, en-GB twice) give two `hreflang_duplicate_pair` findings.

<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">

<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en-GB" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en-GB" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>
